name: Mapillary Vistas
description: Large-scale street-level image dataset with instance-level annotations for visual understanding of street scenes.
citation: Neuhold, G., Ollmann, T., Rota Bulò, S., & Kontschieder, P. (2017). The Mapillary Vistas Dataset for Semantic Understanding of Street Scenes. Proceedings of the IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 4990–4999. https://doi.org/10.1109/ICCV.2017.534
